description: This file contains definitions of grains implementing storage facades, with interfaces and multiple class implementations, demonstrating dependency injection, storage factory patterns, and grain behaviors within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: StorageFacetGrain
classes.description: Implements IStorageFacetGrain, manages multiple storage instances, provides methods to retrieve storage names and extended info.

methods.name: GetNames
methods.description: Returns an array of the names of the storage instances.

methods.name: GetExtendedInfo
methods.description: Returns an array of extended information from the storage instances.

classes.name: StorageFactoryGrain
classes.description: Implements IStorageFactoryGrain, creates storage instances via factory and provides methods to access storage details.

methods.name: GetNames
methods.description: Returns an array of the names of the storage instances.

methods.name: GetExtendedInfo
methods.description: Returns an array of extended information from the storage instances.

classes.name: StorageDefaultFactoryGrain
classes.description: Implements IStorageDefaultFactoryGrain, creates storage instances using default factory and provides access methods.

methods.name: GetNames
methods.description: Returns an array of the names of the storage instances.

methods.name: GetExtendedInfo
methods.description: Returns an array of extended information from the storage instances.

classes.name: StorageDefaultFacetGrain
classes.description: Implements IStorageDefaultFacetGrain, manages storage instances with default facets, supports dependency injection with attribute-based configuration.

methods.name: GetNames
methods.description: Returns an array of the names of the storage instances.

methods.name: GetExtendedInfo
methods.description: Returns an array of extended information from the storage instances.
